title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a₁ = 2 m/s² using kinematic equations with given distance and final speed.

title: Braking force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates resistance force = 9000 N using Newton's second law with bus mass and deceleration.

title: Seat force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates F = 60√26 N as vector sum of horizontal (ma₁) and vertical (mg) components.

title: Kinematic reasoning
description: Important: Applies v² = 2a₁x₁ for acceleration phase and v² = 2a₂x₃ for braking phase with consistent units.

title: Newton's law application
description: Important: Uses F = ma correctly for both bus braking force and student horizontal force components.

title: Force decomposition
description: Important: Recognizes seat force has both horizontal (acceleration-related) and vertical (weight-related) components.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts 43.2 km/h to 12 m/s before calculations and maintains consistent SI units throughout.

title: Vector combination
description: Optional: Uses Pythagorean theorem to combine force components into magnitude correctly.

title: Speed conversion error
description: Pitfall: Fails to convert 43.2 km/h to m/s, leading to incorrect acceleration values.

title: Component omission
description: Pitfall: Calculates only horizontal or only vertical component of seat force, missing vector nature.
